approval_evidence.quote: VYNDAQEL and VYNDAMAX are transthyretin stabilizers indicated for the treatment of the cardiomyopathy of wild type or hereditary transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis in adults to reduce cardiovascular mortality and cardiovascular-related hospitalization

series_start_reason: Vyndaqel was launched in the EU in 2011 and Japan in 2013, but Pfizer's releases and periodic reports did not print it as its own line before the second-quarter 2019 release. That release's prior-year columns give 2018Q2 and six months 2018, so 2018Q1 is derived (72-38); 2018Q3, 2018Q4, 2019Q1 come from later releases' prior-year columns. 2018Q1 is the earliest quarter that can be cited. First U.S. approval 2019 is for the ATTR-CM indication (Vyndaqel/Vyndamax); the earlier ATTR-PN approval was EU 2011 (not evidenced here).
search_log: listed PFE (CIK 0000078003) 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K via data.sec.gov submissions (recent + older pages): 6671 filings; selected 8-Ks with Item 2.02 filed 2015-01 to 2026-08 (53, of which 48 carry an EX-99.1 earnings release; 2022-04-20, 2023-10-13 and 2023-12-14 filings are not quarterly earnings releases; the 2016-02-16 8-K/A carries no usable product table and the original 2016-02-02 release was used)

parsed every release's product tables with scripts/extract.py; quarter row = first occurrence of the product row, year-to-date row = third occurrence (or second where sub-region tables are absent); checked by summing quarters to the printed twelve-month figure
checked every release and 10-Q/10-K 2018-2021: no earlier Vyndaqel figures

label history Vyndaqel -> Vyndaqel/Vyndamax -> Vyndaqel family treated as one product-family series; footnote from 2022Q4: family includes global Vyndaqel plus Vyndamax in the U.S. and Vynmac in Japan

Launch quarter not established from an issuer document: Pfizer 10-Qs/10-Ks 2011-2014 (searched 'launch', 'commercializ', 'first sales' near Vyndaqel/tafamidis): only state EU approval in November 2011 (FY2011 10-K exhibit 13) and U.S. NDA events; no launch or first-sale quarter stated.; Pfizer printed no Vyndaqel sales line before the 2019Q2 release (see series_start_reason), so no first printed nonzero quarter before 2018Q1. launch_quarter null.
